issues.description: Method visibility mismatch for Animal.messageOnFeed(): The UML in problem_statement.md declares messageOnFeed() as public (notation '+ messageOnFeed():String' in the Animal class diagram), whereas the reference implementation declares it as protected (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java: line 18: 'protected abstract String messageOnFeed();'). This discrepancy can confuse students about the intended access level and whether the method should be public in the abstract Animal class.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: change the abstract method declaration in Animal.java to public (public abstract String messageOnFeed();) so it matches the UML/specification in problem_statement.md. Ensure the change compiles and that overriding implementations remain public. Alternative: if the intent was to make the method protected, update the UML/problem statement to show protected visibility (replace '+' with '#' or explicitly note 'protected') so all artifacts agree.
